verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let us then also pray for those who have fallen into any sin, that meekness and humility may be given to them, so that they may submit, not unto us, but to the will of God.
verses.modernizedText: Let us then also pray for those who have fallen into any sin, that meekness and humility may be given to them, so that they may submit not to us but to the will of God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For in this way they shall secure a fruitful and perfect remembrance from us, with sympathy for them, both in our prayers to God, and our mention of them to the saints.
verses.modernizedText: For in this way they shall secure a fruitful and perfect remembrance from us, with sympathy for them both in our prayers to God and in our mention of them to the saints.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let us receive correction, beloved, on account of which no one should feel displeased.
verses.modernizedText: Let us receive correction, beloved, at which no one should be displeased.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Those exhortations by which we admonish one another are both good [in themselves], and highly profitable, for they tend to unite us to the will of God.
verses.modernizedText: Those exhortations by which we admonish one another are both good [in themselves] and highly profitable, for they tend to unite us to the will of God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For thus saith the holy Word: “The Lord hath severely chastened me, yet hath not given me over to death.”
verses.modernizedText: For thus says the holy Word: “The Lord has severely chastened me, yet has not given me over to death.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: “For whom the Lord loveth He chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom He receiveth.”
verses.modernizedText: “For whom the Lord loves He chastens, and scourges every son whom He receives.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: “The righteous,” saith it, “shall chasten me in mercy, and reprove me; but let not the oil of sinners make fat my head.”
verses.modernizedText: “The righteous,” it says, “shall chasten me in mercy and reprove me; but let not the oil of sinners make my head fat.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And again he saith, “Blessed is the man whom the Lord reproveth, and reject not thou the warning of the Almighty.
verses.modernizedText: And again he says, “Blessed is the man whom the Lord reproves, and do not reject the warning of the Almighty.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For He causes sorrow, and again restores [to gladness]; He woundeth, and His hands make whole.
verses.modernizedText: For He causes sorrow and again restores [to gladness]; He wounds, and His hands make whole.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He shall deliver thee in six troubles, yea, in the seventh no evil shall touch thee.
verses.modernizedText: He shall deliver you in six troubles; yes, in the seventh no evil shall touch you.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: In famine He shall rescue thee from death, and in war He shall free thee from the power of the sword.
verses.modernizedText: In famine He shall rescue you from death, and in war He shall free you from the power of the sword.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: From the scourge of the tongue will He hide thee, and thou shalt not fear when evil cometh.
verses.modernizedText: From the scourge of the tongue He will hide you, and you shall not fear when evil comes.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Thou shalt laugh at the unrighteous and the wicked, and shalt not be afraid of the beasts of the field.
verses.modernizedText: You shall laugh at the unrighteous and the wicked, and shall not be afraid of the beasts of the field.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For the wild beasts shall be at peace with thee: then shalt thou know that thy house shall be in peace, and the habitation of thy tabernacle shall not fail.
verses.modernizedText: For the wild beasts shall be at peace with you; then you shall know that your house shall be in peace, and the habitation of your tabernacle shall not fail.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thy children like the grass of the field.
verses.modernizedText: You shall also know that your seed shall be great, and your children like the grass of the field.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And thou shalt come to the grave like ripened corn which is reaped in its season, or like a heap of the threshing-floor which is gathered together at the proper time.”
verses.modernizedText: And you shall come to the grave like ripened grain that is reaped in its season, or like a heap from the threshing floor that is gathered together at the proper time.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Ye see, beloved, that “protection is afforded to those that are chastened of the Lord; for since God is good, He corrects us, that we may be admonished” by His holy chastisement.
verses.modernizedText: You see, beloved, that “protection is afforded to those who are chastened by the Lord; for since God is good, He corrects us, that we may be admonished” by His holy chastisement.
